quest.title: Ah, Fresh Meat!
quest.description: Harris, the chef at the foothill camp, has received inspiration from an ancient recipe and would like to create an all-new gourmet dish. For this, he first requires 10 servings of Chilled Meat...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6, Delicious Goulash x5

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: Just a few more ingredients to go...

dialogues.speaker: Traveler
dialogues.text: What's happening?

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: Hmm? Ah, Traveler. I'm just adding the finishing touches to an ancient recipe.

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: Not long ago, a team of explorers went on an expedition into the mountains. One of them is a friend of mine, an adventurer.

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: They didn't make it very far due to bad weather conditions. But, my friend did tell me that they happened upon an ancient ruin while they were taking shelter from the storm.

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: It was full of books and other records. Even... even a recipe. I don't know how it has survived intact for this long...

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: My adventurer friend passed the recipe on to me. He hopes I can revive the taste of the past.

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: In fact, I've never even heard of some of the ingredients that the recipe requires. Even some of the cooking techniques are new to me.

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: So, I'm cooking a modified version which only uses the most essential ingredients...

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: Would you be willing to help me gather the unusual ingredients from the recipe?

response.speaker: Harris
response.text: Nice to see you're so enthusiastic about this.

response.speaker: Harris
response.text: I heard that a few boar somehow got lost in the mountains and became encased in ice... I'm curious to find out how such an ordeal affects the flavor of the meat.

response.speaker: Harris
response.text: So, perhaps you could fetch me ten portions of Chilled Meat.

response.speaker: Harris
response.text: Yes, as in the meat of those frozen boar. Being encased in ice must keep it pretty fresh, don't you think? So, when someone tells me about some poor boar trapped in the ice, all I hear is "Chilled Meat"...

response.speaker: Harris
response.text: Thanks for doing this for me. Come and find me once you've got the ingredients.

dialogues.speaker: Traveler
dialogues.text: Here's your Chilled Meat.

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: Wow, this Chilled Meat looks pretty good to me... Now I just have one more ingredient left to find.

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: Have you heard of the Great Snowboar King? People say that it's a fierce beast dwelling deep in the mountains...

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: ...And recipes say that its exquisite meat is well-suited to any method of cooking...

dialogues.speaker: Traveler
dialogues.text: Huh... You mean, this?

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: What? Wait... Yes! How... Where? Is this pure coincidence, or...

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: ...Well, anyway... This means I now have all the ingredients I need.

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: While I was waiting for you to get back with the ingredients, I formalized my recipe. If one thing's certain, it's that this is definitely a far cry from the ancient recipe I started with...

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: But as long as the end result tastes good, I'm not concerned about how I get there. I think I'm going to name this dish "Goulash." Sounds exotic but it's very easy to make... Why don't you try for yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I've factored in the difficulty of trying to cook in an inhospitable environment like this. So I kept the preparation time to a minimum and made sure the cooking method is a straightforward one.

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: Go on, give it a try. After you've made it once, you'll find it's easy to remember if you ever want to cook it again.

dialogues.speaker: Traveler
dialogues.text: About the Great Snowboar King meat you wanted...

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: Ah, you've managed to get your hands on some Great Snowboar King meat, have you?

dialogues.speaker: Traveler
dialogues.text: Here you are.

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: Well, in that case... That's all the ingredients accounted for.

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: While I was waiting for you to get back with the ingredients, I formalized my recipe. If one thing's certain, it's that this is definitely a far cry from the ancient recipe I started with...

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: But as long as the end result tastes good, I'm not concerned about how I get there. I think I'm going to name this dish "Goulash." Sounds exotic but it's very easy to make... Why don't you try for yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: Go on, give it a try. After you've made it once, you'll find it's easy to remember if you ever want to cook it again.

dialogues.speaker: Traveler
dialogues.text: Here's your Chilled Meat.

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: Wow, this Chilled Meat looks pretty good to me... Now I just have one more ingredient left to find.

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: Have you heard of the Great Snowboar King? People say that it's a fierce beast dwelling deep in the mountains...

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: ...And recipes say that its exquisite meat is well-suited to any method of cooking...

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: Traveler, would you kindly run this errand for me?

dialogues.speaker: Gameplay
dialogues.text: Could I boldly inquire what's in it for me?

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I have set something aside ready for your return.

talks.objective: Obtain the meat of the Great Snowboar King

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: About the ingredients...

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: *sigh* The right ingredients are so hard to find...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've come for my Goulash.

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: Right on time! It's all ready. Here you go, as promised.

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: Do eat it while it's hot. Remember, hot food is your adventure fuel.

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: Delicious! Nice one, you're a natural.

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: Thanks for your help, and please accept these in return. I need to go cook for some other people now.

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: Oh, one last thing — come and see me again this evening, I'll give you another batch of this food.

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: If you're going to go adventuring in the mountains, you've got to make sure you eat right!

dialogues.speaker: Traveler
dialogues.text: I made some Goulash.

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: Ah! You've finished?

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: About the ingredients...

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: Hmm... Now, what to do with these ingredients...
